continuity_scope: Terms-only audit bound to Wizards of the Coast's 2024 Dungeon Master's Guide (revised fifth edition; official D&D Beyond material labels it ‘5.5e’ as of March 2026) and its official Greyhawk-return announcement. This is one 2024 Greyhawk presentation, not a merger of every TSR, Wizards, Living Greyhawk, novel, adventure, or licensed continuity.

work_or_witnesses.edition: Wizards of the Coast revised fifth-edition core rulebook, 2024

work_or_witnesses.work: Greyhawk Returns in the 2024 Dungeon Master's Guide
work_or_witnesses.edition: Official D&D Beyond announcement, October 21 2024; editorial label clarification March 2 2026

coverage_rule: No individual characters are included because the accessible official product and announcement evidence describe a customizable setting, maps, history, and artifacts but do not provide a stable claim-level profile of a named dramatic individual from the exact witness. Places, setting tools, historical events, factions, deities, monsters, artifacts, and rules remain terms/context.
omissions: All named characters and deities, including figures merely mentioned in product/announcement copy, until a first-party adventure/manual text supplies claim-level individual evidence.
All TSR-era, 3.x, Living Greyhawk, Pathfinder, novel, organized-play, video-game, adaptation, and fan-created continuities.
All core-D&D mechanics, ancestries, classes, alignments, spells, monsters, items, and planes that are not specifically a Greyhawk setting term in the selected witness.
uncertainties: Greyhawk has multiple publications and retcons across editions; this audit makes no continuity reconciliation or source-hierarchy claim beyond privileging the exact 2024 Wizards witness for included terms.
The 2024 product presents Greyhawk as customizable and as a foundation for a DM's own worlds, so content is not a fixed campaign history.
‘2024’ is the rules-edition label. Official D&D Beyond later relabeled the updated fifth-edition content ‘5.5e’ for clarity; that editorial label does not create a separate Greyhawk continuity.
The official errata document is recorded as a version/maintenance boundary, not parsed for setting claims; future updates may change digital presentation.
evidence_basis: Official D&D Beyond/Wizards product and announcement material establishes the exact 2024 product context, Greyhawk's customizable-setting status, Eastern Oerik/Free City map context, the Greyhawk Gazetteer, and selected setting terms. No accessible first-party text profiles named dramatic individuals sufficiently for character records.

supports: 2024 Dungeon Master's Guide as the selected product and Greyhawk's customizable ready-to-use setting role.

supports: 2024/5.5e label clarification, map/gazetteer context, and setting-specific terms.
